name: io.github.joeynyc/microduck-mcp
title: Microduck
description: Drive a Pollen Robotics Microduck (or its MuJoCo sim): walk, sit, kick, camera, health, stop.

environmentVariables.name: DUCK_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Which duck: mock (canned, no setup), sim (run `npx -y microduck-mcp setup-sim` once), ssh (a duck on the network) or unix (on the robot)

environmentVariables.name: DUCK_HOST
environmentVariables.description: ssh target for DUCK_TRANSPORT=ssh, e.g. duck@microduck.local

environmentVariables.name: DUCK_SIM_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where setup-sim installed the simulator, if not the per-user default
